items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: I played at the Rhythm Club with Joe Roversho's band.

ctx.x: When I was with Dave Tholomew, I played at the Robin Hood, and we played up at the, what's the name of this club up on Eagle Street. We stayed up there quite a while. At the Gravestone.
Yeah, I don't know what it was. I played at the Rhythm Club with Joe Roversho's band.
We stayed there quite a while. We used to broadcast from there nationwide and we'd broadcast from there. I've heard of that, that's right.
